def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pts = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    for r,c in pts: out[r][c] = 4
    for k in range(3,10):
        r,c = 3+k,7-k
        if 0 <= r < len(grid) and 0 <= c < len(grid[0]): out[r][c] = 5
    for r in range(2,8): out[r][16] = 5
    return out
